methods.name: init
methods.desc:
Called once by the factory right after funding. Writes metadata, opts into the vote asset,
creates this vote's registry entry (a box in ANOTHER app: the v13 family write), then returns
any unused funding to the creator.

methods.name: voteEscrow
methods.desc: Hard vote: deposit the vote asset. Calling again adds to (and can move) your ballot.

methods.name: voteHeld
methods.desc: Tokens held: weight is read from your wallet. Calling again refreshes it and can change your option.

methods.name: voteNft
methods.desc: NFT collection: each held piece is one vote and can only be counted once.

methods.name: recount
methods.desc: HELD: lower a ballot to the voter's current balance. Anyone can call until the vote ends.

methods.name: recountNft
methods.desc: NFT: remove a piece its voter no longer holds, so the new holder can vote with it.

methods.name: finalize
methods.desc: Anyone, after the end round. Records the winner and decides where escrowed tokens go.

methods.name: payout
methods.desc: Anyone. Sends the whole pool to the return address or the winning option's recipient.

methods.name: fallbackToRefunds
methods.desc: Anyone. If the payout target can't receive (not opted in) for `grace` rounds, refund voters instead.

methods.name: cancel
methods.desc: Creator can cancel before the end. Nobody wins and escrowed tokens are refunded.

methods.name: release
methods.desc:
Anyone, once finalized or cancelled. Deletes a ballot and returns its MBR to the voter. In
refund mode it also returns the voter's escrowed tokens.

methods.name: releaseNft
methods.desc: Anyone, once finalized or cancelled. Deletes an NFT record and returns its MBR to the voter.

methods.name: close
methods.desc:
Called by the factory's closeVote (anyone can trigger it) after every ballot is released.
Sends any stray tokens and all remaining ALGO to the creator, marks the registry entry closed,
and deletes the app. The factory then refunds the app's creation deposit to the creator.

methods.name: opUp
methods.desc: No-op. Clients add it to a group for extra reference slots / opcode budget.

totalEscrow.desc: ESCROW: base units held for voters (sum of open ballots, or the pool before payout).

collection.desc: NFT mode: which assets count (creators + optional unit-name prefix).

nfts.desc: NFT mode: asset ID → voter who counted it.
